category: Tiled 3x3 convolution + fused bias+ReLU via matrix engine (composition)
edge_cases: 3x3 VALID conv lowered to a tiled P x K x C_out matmul, K = C_in*Kh*Kw = 144 (im2col)
8x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles (M=P=256, N=C_out=64); K=144 zero-padded to 5 crouton K-tiles

HMX + uDMA COMPOSE in a partitioned VTCM: weight croutons resident @0x0000 (NTN*NKT*1KB), two double-buffered activation buffers @0x3000/0x6000 (NKT*2KB each), requant-config @0x9000, output crouton @0xA000 -- disjoint regions, no fault

weights are im2col-independent and reused across all M-tiles -> packed + chained-uDMA'd DDR->VTCM ONCE (resident); re-packing weights per output tile is the classic tiling waste that sank a naive first cut (1.005x)

activation crouton is tj-independent -> packed once per M-tile and double-buffered: while HMX computes M-tile ti's whole tj x kt grid, chained uDMA streams M-tile ti+1's im2col croutons into the ALTERNATE VTCM buffer
division-free im2col pack via precomputed koff/poff tables; activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot, weight 4-deep packed, different load limits (2047/1023) in one packet
HMX 0x40-config requant gives r=(acc*17+8)>>4, sign-extended from the 12-bit field; input ranges keep |acc|<=1296 so |r|<2048 (field exact, no HMX saturation)
fused HVX/scalar epilogue: per-output-channel int32 bias -> ReLU -> saturating narrow to uint8; crouton unpack staged via cacheable buffer + bulk 128B vector copies
bias includes extreme (-2000/+2000) and zero edge values so ReLU-zero, uint8-saturate-high, and passthrough all occur
harness installs identity VTCM add_translation AND enables the HMX context so DMA and HMX coexist
harness reference computed via independent HVX vrmpy im2col, cross-checked against a scalar golden on output position p=0
M,N are 32-multiples (crouton requirement), so the classic 128-tail rule does not apply; discrimination via nearmiss + edge bias values
bias-omitted near-miss (still HMX+DMA+VTCM) must fail; note ReLU-omit alone would NOT discriminate since saturate_u8 already clamps negatives
name: i8_conv2d_tiled_bias_relu
signal: compute+bandwidth (tiled im2col matmul; matrix engine + on-chip streaming)
